title: DynTrust-FedIDS++: Optimization-Based Trust Aggregation for Privacy-Aware Byzantine-Robust Federated Intrusion Detection under Data Drift
description:
DynTrust-FedIDS++ is a federated intrusion-detection framework that unifies optimisation-based adaptive aggregation (convex trust-weighted objective solved by FISTA), multi-criteria client trust estimation (performance, gradient consistency, activity, contribution history, 1-Wasserstein distributional residual), Gaussian differential privacy, and explicit evaluation under Byzantine attacks (sign-flip, Gaussian noise, ALIE) and severe class imbalance.

This release contains the corrected real-data experimental pipeline (Google Colab / Jupyter notebook) used in the accompanying manuscript. It evaluates seven aggregation rules on four real flow-level datasets—NF-CSE-CIC-IDS2018, NF-ToN-IoT, UNSW-NB15 and CIDDS-001—under heterogeneous non-IID partitions and a 30% Byzantine participation scenario.

Under 30% Byzantine + ALIE + mild DP (σ=0.05) the proposed optimisation aggregator attains balanced accuracy 0.646 and minority-class recall 0.942, outperforming classical robust aggregators. An explicit trust-module audit shows that current trust scores do not reliably separate honest from Byzantine clients; performance gains are driven primarily by the iterative FISTA aggregation step.

Datasets are not redistributed; obtain them from the original public sources listed in the manuscript Data Availability Statement.
